description: This Java class 'ModelFieldType' models a field type in the Apache OFBiz entity framework, including attributes like type, Java type, SQL type, and associated JDBC handler. It provides methods for retrieving these attributes and estimating string length based on SQL type.

classes.name: ModelFieldType
classes.description: Represents a field type in the entity model, encapsulating type information and JDBC handling.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type of the field.

methods.name: getJdbcValueHandler
methods.description: Returns the JDBC value handler for this field type.

methods.name: getSqlType
methods.description: Returns the SQL type of the field.

methods.name: getSqlTypeAlias
methods.description: Returns the SQL type alias of the field.

methods.name: stringLength
methods.description: Estimates the maximum string length based on the SQL type.
